verdict.rationale: The only robots.txt probe, on the transactional host secure.esd.wa.gov behind EAMS and quarterly filing, returned HTTP 200 with the SecureAccess Washington login page rather than an actual robots policy. That gives an agent no machine-readable crawl rules. No evidence shows a real robots.txt on the main esd.wa.gov site either, though that host was not probed, so confidence is medium rather than high.
